subject: Novatech POC: kickoff scheduling & success criteria
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novatech.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Novatech POC: kickoff scheduling & success criteria

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We’re excited to get the Novatech proof-of-concept started. To make the kickoff productive we typically run a 60-minute multi-stakeholder session that covers:
- Success criteria & acceptance tests
- High-level timeline and milestone owners
- Basic environment/integration checklist (who owns VPN/keys/whitelisting)
- Short demo + immediate next steps

Who from your side needs to be at the initial meeting? Based on past POCs we ask to include: engineering (API/integration owners), procurement (contract/PO questions), and security/compliance. If you can confirm names and roles we’ll lock the invite.

Proposed windows next week (all PT):
- Tue 8/31: 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 9/1: 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00

Irene (SE) and Dev (Solutions Eng) are copied — we’ll own the demo and integration checklist. I’ve attached a 1-page draft success-criteria doc that you can edit/comment on ahead of the meeting.

Attachments: Novatech-POC-success-criteria.docx

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Thanks Jordan — sounds good. I’m looping in our procurement alias and Tim from security so we have the right people on the thread.

From our side:
- Attendees: me (Head of Eng), Tim Ho (Security), procurement@novatech.com (PO/contract lead). I’ll also invite Alex (platform engineer) once we confirm a slot.
- Availability windows (ET): Tue 8/31 12:00–13:00, Wed 9/1 12:00–13:00, Thu 9/2 09:00–11:00.
- Security note: we’ll need an overview of how you handle logs, retention, and whether data is routed to Redwood-hosted endpoints vs. private deployment. I’ve attached our standard security questionnaire excerpts for your reference.

If procurement needs a separate pre-call to discuss PO timing/terms we can set that up, otherwise they’ll join the kickoff.

Best,
Samira Khan

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Novatech POC: kickoff scheduling & success criteria

Folks — forwarding Samira’s reply. Quick notes and suggested owners so we’re aligned before I respond with a firm time:

Planned owners for kickoff:
- AE / commercial intro + objectives: Jordan
- Technical demo (data flow, API call patterns, KV/cache behavior): Irene (me)
- Integration/infrastructure & whitelisting: Dev Patel
- Post-POC handoff / success tracking: Stephanie (CS)

Responses to Samira’s asks:
- Security: I’ll prepare a short slide and call out: logs & retention (configurable per-customer), options for private deployment (VPC/on-prem), and what we redact in hosted logs.
- Procurement: if they want a separate PO/terms chat we can schedule a 20-min slot; otherwise we’ll keep them on the kickoff to avoid extra meetings.

Conflicts: I’m blocked Tue morning and Wed 11:00–12:30. Dev says he’s out Wed morning but can make Tue 14:00 PT (that’s Wed 17:00 ET). Jordan — can you prioritize a Wed 9:00 PT / 12:00 ET slot (that intersects Samira’s Wed 12:00 ET availability)? If we can, I’ll send the calendar invite and attach the success criteria doc and the proposed agenda.

Proposed short agenda (60m):
1) 5m – intros & objectives (Jordan)
2) 15m – success criteria & acceptance tests (Jordan + Samira)
3) 20m – demo: integration points + common blockers (Irene)
4) 10m – procurement/contract & timeline (procurement lead)
5) 10m – next steps & owners (group)
